title: A foothold for restoration
notice: Costs, timings, funding decisions and illustrative observations are scenario inputs. User-reported ownership and measurements are unverified; no grant eligibility or ecological recovery is certified.

outline.title: Find your foothold
outline.description: Record existing ownership or establish access through one of seven routes.

outline.title: Demonstrate
outline.description: Plan, baseline, plant, monitor and evaluate a dryland pilot.

outline.title: Find support
outline.description: Check AL20 3.4 before planting; awards and reimbursements remain separate.

outline.title: Grow the work
outline.description: Expand restoration; optionally form a company.

outline.title: Connect more land
outline.description: Arrange more land, review permissions and renew temporary access.

outline.title: Take stock
outline.description: Review land, cash, organizations and completed work.

actions.title: Establish land access
actions.description: Compare seven routes, configure a parcel and agreement, and preview costs and duration. You can also record existing ownership.

actions.title: Finalise a land proposal
actions.description: Review the missing terms and explicitly assume agreement/approval for this fictional scenario.

actions.title: Renew temporary access
actions.description: Explicitly extend an active or expired temporary agreement. Existing maintenance commitments remain.

actions.title: End land access
actions.description: End an arrangement and receive its held deposit. Ownership and continuing maintenance obligations remain.

actions.title: Plan the demonstrator
actions.description: Choose a planting-led pilot, demonstration method, budget and potential funding route. Planning does not plant anything or receive funding.

actions.title: Record the baseline
actions.description: Record starting conditions and site readiness before planting.

actions.title: Record funding feedback
actions.description: Record pending, positive or negative eligibility feedback; the simulator never certifies eligibility.

actions.title: Record the AL20 3.4 application
actions.description: Record a submitted application after funding feedback, before planting. No cash is received.
actions.outcome: Grant application submitted and pending. No award or payment has been received.

actions.title: Record the funding decision
actions.description: Explicitly record a pending decision, award or rejection. No award is automatic and an award adds no cash.
actions.outcome: Fictional ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬40,000 grant awarded. The award is pending payment and is not available cash.

actions.title: Plant the demonstrator
actions.description: Pay the configured planting budget and record installed work. Access must cover planting and the planned follow-up.

actions.title: Record follow-up observations
actions.description: At or after the planned follow-up date, enter observed or explicitly illustrative plant-survival data.

actions.title: Evaluate and share results
actions.description: Record an interpretation, next step and dissemination status. No ecological success is inferred automatically.

actions.title: Record the reimbursement
actions.description: Record a received reimbursement after eligible expenditure and results reporting. Payment is capped by the reported award and spending.
actions.outcome: Grant payment received once. The award amount is now included in available cash.

actions.title: Expand restoration
actions.description: Choose an available parcel and the restoration work area in m². The displayed action cost is fixed and does not scale with area.

actions.title: Create a company
actions.description: Optional organizational step. Existing land stays with its current owner.
actions.outcome: Company established alongside the project. No land ownership or access has been transferred.

actions.title: Establish a foundation
actions.description: Optional continuity step, with or without a company. Existing land arrangements remain intact.
actions.outcome: Foundation established. Any company continues to exist; parcel ownership and access remain unchanged.

actions.title: Advance time
actions.description: Move to a later year, at most year 30. Scheduled land payments, deposit returns and expiries are processed at their due times.
actions.outcome: Time advanced; scheduled payments and access expiries have been processed. Pending grants remain pending.

land_routes.title: Stewardship agreement
land_routes.description: Conservation cooperation with the landowner and an existing nonprofit partner.
land_routes.caveat: Specify actual access and conservation responsibilities; stewardship alone is not ownership.
land_routes.source: COAST-001, PDF pp. 5-6; COAST-002, PDF pp. 9-12

land_routes.title: Free use
land_routes.description: Use land without rent under an explicit, limited agreement.
land_routes.caveat: No rent does not mean no maintenance costs. Check notice and return conditions.

land_routes.title: Long-term lease
land_routes.description: Pay scheduled rent for agreed uses; the owner retains ownership.
land_routes.caveat: Rent is paid annually in advance. The applicable legal lease regime remains unverified.

land_routes.title: Usufruct
land_routes.description: Record a time-limited right to use land, separate from ownership.
land_routes.caveat: Record scope and formalisation. No statutory validity or tax treatment is determined here.

land_routes.title: Public-land management
land_routes.description: Manage specified public land under an assumed authorisation or agreement.
land_routes.caveat: A proposal provides no access. The competent authority and authorising instrument must be identified.
land_routes.source: COAST-001, PDF pp. 5-6; FUND-003, PDF p. 39

land_routes.title: Land donation
land_routes.description: Transfer ownership to the named recipient after assumed acceptance and completion.
land_routes.caveat: An offer is not a completed transfer. Formalities, charges and tax consequences remain unverified.

land_routes.title: Purchase
land_routes.description: Purchase a parcel for the named buyer, separately from its operator.
land_routes.caveat: Price is fictional; no market valuation or grant eligibility is implied.

land_routes.title: Record existing ownership
land_routes.description: Record land you already own at the current project year, with no acquisition, transfer or automatic maintenance commitment.
land_routes.caveat: Ownership is reported by you, not verified by the simulator. Recording it takes no simulation time.
